create_RadianceFieldRenderer: create a RadianceFieldRenderer with coarse and fine rendering passes for neural radiance field rendering
run_forward_rendering: run the forward pass of RadianceFieldRenderer to render coarse and fine RGB images from a camera viewpoint
precache_camera_rays: precache rays emitted from a list of cameras using RadianceFieldRenderer precache_rays method
process_ray_chunk: process a chunk of rays through coarse and fine rendering passes using _process_ray_chunk method
visualize_nerf_outputs: visualize NeRF rendering outputs including coarse fine renders and camera rays with Visdom
